_about: The shared base for Thai VOCATIONAL curricula (อาชีวศึกษา, สอศ.: ปวช. / ปวส.). Hours are printed in separate columns ท ป น (theory hours, practice hours, credits a week), not 3(2-2-5). A college's plan template names this in "extends" and adds its own layout. Data, not code. Regexes marked (cmp) run on the COMPARABLE form of a line: no spaces, no Thai marks, ำ read as า.
name: Thai vocational curriculum (สอศ.) - base
_credit_columns: the last numbers of a row, in this order: ท (theory hours) ป (practice hours) น (credits)
_practice_per_credit: the credit rule: credits = theory + practice / 2 (classroom) or / 3 (workshop, workplace); an activity has 0 credits and only practice hours. A reading that breaks it is red
_activity_code: กิจกรรมเสริมหลักสูตร (20000-2001 ปวช., 30000-2001 ปวส.): 2 hours a week, no room, no credit - still placed
term: ภาคเรยน(?:ท(?P<t>[0-9Ss])|(?P<w>ฤดรอน))(?:ปการศกษา(?P<acyear>[0-9]{4}))?
_term: (cmp) ภาคเรียนที่ 1 ปีการศึกษา 2569: the year of study comes from the academic year (the first one of a plan = year 1)
_year: vocational plans name the academic year, not ชั้นปีที่
total: ^หนวยกตประจาภาค
_total: (cmp) หน่วยกิตประจำภาคเรียน 17 | 26 | 27 - the term's sums, checked against the rows (only the start: OCR misspells the rest)
plan_word: แผนการเรยน
course_list_heading: ^(?:[0-9.]+)?คาอธบายรายวชา
_border_marks: table lines (and the stray quotes OCR makes of them) next to a code: |30000-1202|, 30001-1002], |30102-2020"
_column_header: (cmp) the first column header of a plan table: where a second table side by side starts
_glyph_pass: off: the glyph pass learns code / 3(2-2-5) credit shapes (university layout); ruled vocational tables are read by the cell pass (measured on Sattahip: glyph 13 red, cell pass 1)
_term_lookalikes: ภาคเรียนที่ S = summer (term 3). OCR reads the printed S as 5; there is no term 5 in a vocational plan, so 5 there is an S (amber, with the reason)
_credit_dashed: a course LIST (no term plan) prints the hours as one word ท-ป-น: 1-4-3 (theory 1, practice 4, credits 3)
list_group: กลม|หมวด|ปรบพนฐาน
_list_group: (cmp) a COURSE LIST (no term plan): a line without a code matching this is the heading the next subjects sit under; list_elective in it = elective subjects (กลุ่มสมรรถนะวิชาชีพเลือก, หมวดวิชาเลือกเสรี), list_conditional = only some students take them (รายวิชาปรับพื้นฐานวิชาชีพ: graduates of ม.6, not ปวช.)
